newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil Sakai topper start-up unclear.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil Sakai topper start-up unclear.

text.p: The start-up date of Cosmo Oil Co Ltd's 110,000 barrels-per-day crude distillation unit, which was shut on Thursday due to a fire, will not become clear until next week, a refinery official said on Friday.
"An investigation into the cause of the fire is continuing and we will not know when operations will resume until next week," the official said.

A Cosmo Oil spokesman said on Thursday that any shortages arising from the closure of the Sakai refinery in central Japan would be covered by measures such as increasing throughput at the nearby Sakaide refinery.
Importing oil products was another possible alternative, a Cosmo Oil trader said on Thursday.
Cosmo Oil had a company holiday on Friday to celebrate its founding.
